sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Install:

```bash
pip install pip-audit
```

Run:

```bash
pip-audit
```

This checks installed Python packages against known vulnerability information.

You can also use:

```bash
pip freeze > requirements.txt
```

But remember: a dependency list is not a complete security guarantee.

For stronger reproducibility and integrity, use a lock file with hashes, trusted package sources and controlled build pipelines.

quiz.question: What is the most production-ready mindset for "5. Practical Python security checks"?
options: Trust fluent model output without checks
Define detect → mitigate → validate loops around the concept
Only optimize prompts and ignore systems design
quiz.explanation: Production GenAI systems need explicit detection, mitigation, and validation around every critical concept.
